steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Gradient: The steepness of a line. Found by dividing vertical change by horizontal change. | Intercepts: y-intercept: Where the line crosses the y-axis (when x = 0) x-intercept: Where the line crosses the x-axis (when y = 0)

steps.title: Lesson 3: Application
steps.body: Find the gradient of the line passing through (0, 2) and (4, 10). | Find the y-intercept of y = 5x - 8. | Find the x-intercept of y = 3x + 9.

steps.title: Lesson 4: Exam Practice
steps.body: Extended Answer 6 marks: Two water tanks are being drained. Tank A: d = 120 - 8t. Tank B: d = 100 - 5t. d = depth in cm, t = time in minutes. (a) Which tank starts fuller?
